theorem D0.Geometry.physicalMovingWard_of_constitutiveAction.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4, u_5} : ∀ {P0 : Type u_1}
  {P1 : Type u_2} {D3 : Type u_3} {D4 : Type u_4} [inst : Fintype P0] [inst_1 : Fintype P1] [inst_2 : Fintype D3]
  [inst_3 : Fintype D4] [DecidableEq P0] [DecidableEq P1] [DecidableEq D3] [DecidableEq D4] {Background : Type u_5}
  (geometryAction : Background → ℝ) (symmetry : Background → Background) (b : Background)
  (e0 : FiniteRealCarrier P0 ≃ₗ[ℝ] Module.Dual ℝ (FiniteRealCarrier D4))
  (e1 : FiniteRealCarrier P1 ≃ₗ[ℝ] Module.Dual ℝ (FiniteRealCarrier D3))
  (Q0 : FiniteRealCarrier P0 ≃ₗ[ℝ] FiniteRealCarrier P0) (Q1 : FiniteRealCarrier P1 ≃ₗ[ℝ] FiniteRealCarrier P1)
  (dPof : Background → FiniteRealCarrier P0 →ₗ[ℝ] FiniteRealCarrier P1)
  (dDof : Background → FiniteRealCarrier D3 →ₗ[ℝ] FiniteRealCarrier D4)
  (S0of : Background → FiniteRealCarrier P0 →ₗ[ℝ] FiniteRealCarrier D4)
  (S1of : Background → FiniteRealCarrier P1 →ₗ[ℝ] FiniteRealCarrier D3) (psi chi lambda : FiniteRealCarrier P0),
  geometryAction (symmetry b) = geometryAction b ∧
      dPof (symmetry b) = movedPrimalDifferential Q0 Q1 (dPof b) ∧
        dDof (symmetry b) = movedDualDifferential (dualAction e1 Q1) (dualAction e0 Q0) (dDof b) ∧
          S0of (symmetry b) = movedStar (dualAction e0 Q0) Q0 (S0of b) ∧
            S1of (symmetry b) = movedStar (dualAction e1 Q1) Q1 (S1of b) →
    have pairing := fun p d => (e0 p) d;
    have A := { dP := dPof b, dD := dDof b, star0 := S0of b, star1 := S1of b };
    have A' :=
      { dP := dPof (symmetry b), dD := dDof (symmetry b), star0 := S0of (symmetry b), star1 := S1of (symmetry b) };
    mixedPrimalDualAction pairing A' (Q0 psi) (Q0 chi) (Q0 lambda) = mixedPrimalDualAction pairing A psi chi lambda :=
fun {P0} {P1} {D3} {D4} [Fintype P0] [Fintype P1] [Fintype D3] [Fintype D4] [DecidableEq P0] [DecidableEq P1]
    [DecidableEq D3] [DecidableEq D4] {Background} geometryAction symmetry b e0 e1 Q0 Q1 dPof dDof S0of S1of psi chi
    lambda hDerived =>
  let pairing := fun p d => (e0 p) d;
  let A := { dP := dPof b, dD := dDof b, star0 := S0of b, star1 := S1of b };
  let A' :=
    { dP := dPof (symmetry b), dD := dDof (symmetry b), star0 := S0of (symmetry b), star1 := S1of (symmetry b) };
  And.casesOn hDerived fun left right =>
    And.casesOn right fun hdP right =>
      And.casesOn right fun hdD right =>
        And.casesOn right fun hS0 hS1 =>
          have hdata :=
            of_eq_true
              (Eq.trans
                (congrFun' (congrArg Eq (congr (congr (congr (congrArg FinitePrimalDualHodgeData.mk hdP) hdD) hS0) hS1))
                  { dP := movedPrimalDifferential Q0 Q1 (dPof b),
                    dD := movedDualDifferential (dualAction e1 Q1) (dualAction e0 Q0) (dDof b),
                    star0 := movedStar (dualAction e0 Q0) Q0 (S0of b),
                    star1 := movedStar (dualAction e1 Q1) Q1 (S1of b) })
                (eq_self
                  { dP := movedPrimalDifferential Q0 Q1 (dPof b),
                    dD := movedDualDifferential (dualAction e1 Q1) (dualAction e0 Q0) (dDof b),
                    star0 := movedStar (dualAction e0 Q0) Q0 (S0of b),
                    star1 := movedStar (dualAction e1 Q1) Q1 (S1of b) }));
          Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrFun'
                (congrArg Eq
                  (congrFun'
                    (congrFun' (congrFun' (congrArg (mixedPrimalDualAction fun p d => (e0 p) d) hdata) (Q0 psi))
                      (Q0 chi))
                    (Q0 lambda)))
                (mixedPrimalDualAction (fun p d => (e0 p) d) A psi chi lambda)))
            (mixedAction_transform e0 e1 Q0 Q1 A psi chi lambda)

  (e1 : FiniteRealCarrier P1 ≃ₗ[ℝ] Module.Dual ℝ (FiniteRealCarrier D3))
